prompt: Create exactly one 9:16 vertical style reference sheet — a texture and palette sample, not a scene. Medium: linocut relief print. Texture family: matte carved-print ink with salt-bloom speckling, fibrous grain, dry roller breakup and subtle edge chatter. Palette: deep marine indigo, weathered turquoise, sun-bleached sand and bone white, dry palm brown, storm gray, with sparse rust-orange accents reserved for salt stress, injury and survival hazards. Line treatment: bold carved contours with controlled crosshatching, simplified anatomical cutaways and clear directional flow marks; organic irregularity without embedded labels or lettering. Lighting: hard tropical daylight with crisp directional shadows, softened only during rain or storm beats while preserving the same high-contrast print logic. Avoid: No enclosing pages or entry-object masks; no embedded text or unsupported factual imagery. No characters, no text, no logos, no photorealism. [VISUAL_CONTRACT:material_anchor_v2] Fill the canvas with a neutral material/palette sample, not a framed page, book, landscape, gateway, inset illustration or host.
